name: game-bot-control
title: Game Bot Control
author: awm
description: Per-seat control of real multiplayer players over RCON: a seat registry keyed by player index, pathfinded movement, real (engine-driven) mining, the real crafting queue, build/insert/take, cheat-flagged research, a drainable events buffer, and a tool registry of named, persistent call and lib tools. State lives in `storage` so seats survive save/load.
